name: txtai
summary: All-in-one open-source Python framework for semantic search, RAG, LLM pipelines, workflows and agents, with Web and MCP APIs.
description: Its embeddings database combines vector indexes, graph networks and relational storage. Agents are built on smolagents. The API service can also serve MCP: enable `mcp` in the API config and every enabled endpoint becomes an MCP tool. Bindings for JavaScript, Java, Rust and Go. `pip install txtai` (Python 3.11+, Apache-2.0). Latest release v9.14.0 (Oct 2026).
